title: My House
text:
This is my house. It has three rooms. In the living room there is a big sofa and a table. The sofa is blue.

My bedroom has a bed and a wardrobe. There is a lamp next to the bed. I like my room because it is quiet. My favorite piece of furniture is the chair by the window.

questions.text: How many rooms does the house have?
How does the writer probably feel about their home?
What can we guess about the lamp next to the bed?
options: It is probably used to give light at night
It is a kind of bed

vocabulary.definition: parts of a house enclosed by walls, such as a bedroom or a kitchen
a long, soft seat for two or more people
a tall piece of furniture where you keep clothes

paragraph_translations: Esta es mi casa. Tiene tres habitaciones. En la sala hay un sofá grande y una mesa. El sofá es azul.
Mi dormitorio tiene una cama y un armario. Hay una lámpara al lado de la cama. Me gusta mi habitación porque es tranquila. Mi mueble favorito es la silla junto a la ventana.
